Going from steady-state to dynamic is slow and fragile

Every process engineer who has opened the Dynamics mode knows the pain.

Manual equipment sizing

Vessels, drums and valves each need volumes and dimensions entered one by one.

Setup that breaks

Missing pressure or flow specs and unsized units are easy to miss and cause the simulation to fail.

No clear record

It is hard to show what was sized, why, and with which method.

Meet the HYSYS Copilot

The first product from Trust Industrial Intelligence AI. A team of AI agents works with your open HYSYS case so you do not have to click through every step.

Equipment sizing. Sizes equipment using HYSYS's own sizing methods, driven automatically through Windows COM.
Universal datasheet parser. Reads vendor datasheets in different formats and uses them to size equipment.
Dynamic setup. Helps with the steps that turn a steady-state case into a dynamic one.
Execution log. Every action is logged, so you can review exactly what was done.

How it works

STEP 1

Download and open

Install the app on the same Windows PC as HYSYS.

STEP 2

Point it to your case

Enter the location of your HYSYS file so the copilot can find it.

STEP 3

Run the agents

Review the sized flowsheet and the log of what was changed.

Who it is for

Students

Spend your time understanding dynamic behavior, not repeating setup steps in your course project or final-year work.

Engineers

Young engineers and teams at small and mid-sized firms who want faster, more traceable dynamic case preparation.

Requirements and privacy

Know exactly what you are installing.

You need

Windows PC
Internet connection (the AI uses Google Gemini)
Licensed Aspen HYSYS V10
The location of your HYSYS case file

Your data

The app runs on your PC and talks to HYSYS locally through Windows COM
Reads only the case you point it to
The AI agent uses the Google Gemini API. None of your proprietary case or equipment data is sent to it
Nothing is sent to or stored on our servers
The execution log is shown on screen and is not saved to a file
Sizing is applied to your open HYSYS case. Save it yourself, and keep a backup copy first
